purpose: Stage measured mobile rendering and interaction pressure into runtime-state-v1 without modifying LEEWAY-FORMULA-v1.0. The mapping is for adaptive policy research only until calibrated and verified.

dimensions.definition: measured rendered-frame duration over the active observation window
measured long-task duration attributable to the application during the observation window
active Cesium/browser render scale relative to nominal 1.0
number of simultaneously animated map subjects requiring continuous visual updates
number of enabled source-backed live layers contributing polling, decoding, rendering or animation
measured time from user interaction to corresponding visible/state response

observationWindow.rule: 16 consecutive completed runtime observations under the same device class, app version, render policy and map workload identity

deterministicBaseline.rule: Before Formula calibration, apply conservative capability-based policies using viewport, standardized browser hardware hints, render scale, and feature cost. Never claim Formula optimized the device unless the canonical evaluator actually executes.

crossPlatformBoundary.web: WebGPU or WebGL are browser graphics APIs to the device GPU; they are not a second physical GPU.
crossPlatformBoundary.androidNative: Native GPU compute/render may use platform graphics/compute APIs when a native package owns the workload.
crossPlatformBoundary.appleNative: Apple devices use integrated Apple GPUs; native workloads use Metal. Browser WebGPU, where available, is a web API layered over the platform graphics stack.
crossPlatformBoundary.coordinationRule: Do not double-submit the same visual workload through native GPU and WebGPU and call that additive GPU capacity. Separate workloads only when synchronization cost and power impact are measured.

prohibitions: Do not infer GPU model or memory when the browser does not expose it.
Do not claim PWA installation grants native GPU privileges.
Do not claim WebGPU and the phone GPU are two independent GPUs.
Do not execute Formula before calibration ranges and performance contribution tests exist.
veritasAcceptance: Frame time and interaction latency are measured, not estimated.
The same trace and policy reproduce the same staged rows.
Adaptive policies never change factual map truth states.
Performance reductions do not disable safety-critical or journey-critical evidence silently.
Canonical Formula and runtime-state adapter hashes match authority pins.
Ablation demonstrates any Formula-selected policy outperforms the deterministic baseline before promotion.
reason: Performance mapping has been staged only. Mobile calibration and controlled baseline comparison have not been completed.
